title: build week — bank the bike before Lisbon
context: Not racing Saturday (Pescadero is on the calendar but skipped) → normal build week, not a taper.
Next week is a Lisbon travel week with no bike → this is the last chance to ride hard for ~10 days.

⚠️ Rotation deviation: wk of 07-06 was also ride-vo2, so this week breaks bike↔run alternation. Deliberate — losing bike access next week outweighs strict rotation. Next week returns to run-intervals.
constraints: Evenings are booked all week (Nopa Thu, Date night Thu 7:30pm, Local Edition Sat) → all sessions morning/midday
Thu 07-16 Bike Club 1:30–3:30pm is optional — skipped in favour of the dumbbell lift
philosophy: Cyclist's goal week: get one last bike VO2 + one long endurance ride in before a ~10-day bike drought in Lisbon.
Fresh form (TSB +14) → safe to hit real intensity Friday.
Strength stays 2/wk (Mon heavy barbell + Thu dumbbell, >24h apart) — don't drop strength to add cardio.

events.title: 🚴 Bike VO2 intervals
events.why: Last bike quality before ~10 days off the bike; TSB +14 supports it
events.description: 15' WU. Main: 5×3min @ 300–320W (Z5, HR pushing 168–182), 3' easy spin between. 10' CD. Zwift OK. Last bike quality before ~10 days off the bike (Lisbon). Sub 2×20' SST @ 235–250W if legs are cooked from yesterday's lift. ~85 TSS.

events.title: 🚴 Long endurance ride (Z2)
events.why: Last real ride before the Lisbon bike drought — bank the aerobic time
events.description: 2.5h steady Z2, 170–200W / HR <153. Last real ride before Lisbon travel week — bank the aerobic time. AM fog possible (12–17°C), dress in layers. ~150 TSS.

events.title: 🏃 Easy recovery run
events.why: Flush the legs after the long ride
events.description: 45' Z1–Z2, 5:50–6:10/km, fully conversational. Flush the legs after the long ride. Keep it genuinely easy. ~50 TSS.
